status_detail: This diagram was generated from the model source and opened once by real MathWorks MATLAB. It has never been run. No number anywhere in this project derives from it — every metric comes from the base pipeline, which needs no Simulink at all.
topology_note: Block names and types are read from the .slx itself and match, one for one, the topology read out of buildSimulinkModel.m by hand during Phase 0 — the source read confirmed by the artifact.
connections_note: Connection counts are NOT claimed equal to the source. buildSimulinkModel.m calls add_line 15 times; the saved file encodes fan-out as branches, so the counts differ by construction. Asserting they match without checking the graph would be a claim beyond the evidence.
